dct_creator_sm: Belko, Alexis Paul (Université Laval). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2830-6269
dct_description_sm: The swath bathymetry dataset is a compilation of several AUV surveys in the Laurentian Channel during two oceanographic cruises in 2020 and 2021 onboard the RV Coriolis II.  It also includes the results of each mapped pockmark (as a shapefile), as well as all the pockmark classification information presented in the submitted paper For questions, please contact alexis.belko.1@ulaval.ca. (2026-08-06)
dct_title_s: Data used in "Pockmark morphology and carbonate crust detection from very-high-resolution swath bathymetry in the Laurentian Channel (eastern Canada)"
